neighbours.label: the physical body (body, bodies, physically), the other side of the - pole's mind/behaviour/mood
fire: Yoga helps you relax your body after a long day.
Swimming is great for staying physically fit.
Athletes push their bodies to the limit every season.
The massage eased the tension in my whole body.
Dancing keeps older adults physically active and strong.
Proper sleep lets the body repair damaged muscle.
Hard work on the farm made their bodies lean and tough.
She felt physically exhausted after the marathon.
quiet: Yoga helps you relax your mind after a long day.
Reading is great for staying mentally sharp.
Athletes push their limits with mental training every season.
The music eased the tension in my thoughts.
Clubs keep older adults socially active and happy.
Proper sleep lets the mind sort new memories.
Hard work on the farm made them patient and humble.
She felt emotionally drained after the argument.

notes: The - pole fires on behavioral/mood/personality/temperament; the + pole on body/physical. Near misses swap the body word for a mind word.
